headline: Monetary Authority of Singapore warns banks over financing haze-linked companies
summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore stated that domestic financial institutions should review lending relationships with palm oil and forestry operators linked to recurring regional transboundary haze.
why: Singapore serves as Southeast Asia's primary green and transition finance hub, subjecting local bank loan books to stringent ESG due diligence criteria.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Banks face enhanced compliance scrutiny and possible divestment requirements from high-emission forestry clients.
